content: स्फुट् I. €6 <ab>P.</ab> €1 <ab>U.</ab> (स्फुटति, स्पोटति-ते, स्फुटित) .²1 To burst or split open, break forth, be suddenly rent asunder, cleave, split, break; हा हा देवि स्फुटति हृदयं स्रंसते देहबन्धः <ls>U. 3. 38</ls>; स्फुटति न सा मनसिजविशिखेन <ls>Gīt. 7</ls>; <ls>Bk. 14. 56</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">15. 77</ls>. .²2 To expand, open, blow, blossom; स्फुटति कुसुमनिकरे विरहिहृदयदलनाय <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 136</ls>; <ls>Kāv. 3. 167</ls>. .²3 To run or bound away, disperse; तुरङ्गाः पुस्फुटुर्भीताः <ls>Bk. 14. 6</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">10. 8</ls>. .²4 To become visible, burst into view, become evident or manifest. .²5 To abate (as a disease). --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (स्फुटयति-ते) .²1 To burst, crack, break open. .²2 To burst into view. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (स्फोटयतिते) .²1 To burst or rend asunder, split, tear open, cleave, divide. .²2 To manifest, show, make clear. .²3 To disclose, divulge, make public. .²4 To hurt, destroy, kill. .²5 To winnow.
